Gates were announced before they were built: several 'gates' are documents until coded (F1 lesson, recurring).
Duplicates keep being born: two stores, two DESIGN-LANGUAGE files, six rival button systems, two registries; entropy wins by default.
Score inflation pressure: self-scores drift up (a maker's 9.0 corrected to 7.0 by a sister, twice this week).
Interruption economics: cold restarts rebuild context from records; thin records are paid for in re-asking (SLA asks aging >30h).
The director's attention is the scarcest resource — and still a routing layer for escalations, ratifications, and sweep merges.
Unfinished adjudications linger: the collision five (SN-1852/1904/1906/1907/1908) and Booking's two versions of one ask.
The live surface and the record diverge: counts quoted from memory go stale within hours ('446 rows' didn't reproduce; the 815 slip).
We optimize lanes, not the river: the system constraint (landings, proof, the mount) sits between lanes, owned by no single queue.
